title: Adaptive Execution System — LOC-Driven Real-Time Parameter Adjustment
brief: Real-time parameter adjustment as LOC/engagement changes during execution. RPM, feed, stepover auto-adjust on 3D adaptive roughing. Handles ever-evolving cutting conditions: tool wear, thermal drift, material variability. Closes the loop between CAM plan (MS4) and execution (shop floor).
user_directive_coverage: Directly addresses: 'as length of cut changes on 3D adaptive roughing toolpaths, rpm, feed rate and step over should be adjusted automatically'

smart_config.role: Real-Time Systems Engineer + CNC Control Specialist
must_include: Engagement calculation: ae_actual from spindle load / force telemetry
PRISM Kienzle model + Taylor tool life
WEDM failsafe patterns (22 safety hooks reference)
Fanuc FOCAS, Okuma THINC API, Haas MachineConnect

units.title: LOCRealtimeSensingEngine — live LOC extraction from telemetry
units.intent: Extract live length-of-cut and radial engagement from machine telemetry (spindle load, axis force, acoustic emission). Fuse multi-sensor signals into ae_actual estimate at 100Hz.

loops.loop_1_build: Sensor fusion (Kalman): spindle load + feed force + acoustic. Inverse Kienzle to estimate ae. Sampling @ 100Hz with 10ms latency target.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Signal processing PhD + control engineer. Check: Kalman tuning stability, sensor outlier rejection, latency budget.
loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Multi-tool compensation (different kc1 per tool/material), sensor-failure fallback.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Live ae estimate within ±15% of ground truth (CMM measurement after cut) on 20 test cuts.
exit_gate.rollback_procedure: git revert; revert to open-loop CAM plan.

units.description: LOCRealtimeSensingEngine — live LOC extraction from telemetry — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: ToolEngagementGeometryEngine — pre-compute engagement map
units.intent: Pre-simulate every toolpath step → ae/ap map along path. 3D adaptive roughing has wildly varying ae — pre-computing at 1mm arc-length resolution gives baseline for sense/actuate loop.

loops.loop_1_build: Stock-aware simulation. Marching along path. ae/ap sample at each micro-step. Output JSON engagement map.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: CAM simulation expert + computational geometry PhD. Check: stock update accuracy, corner case handling (internal corners, step-over transitions).

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Engagement map accuracy within 10% of commercial CAM simulation (Vericut cross-check) on 15 parts.
exit_gate.abort_criteria: If sim time > 5min per program (too slow for online use).

units.description: ToolEngagementGeometryEngine — pre-compute engagement map — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: ToolWearRealtimeEstimatorEngine — online wear via Taylor+ sensors
units.intent: Estimate current tool wear from cumulative cutting time × load × temperature. Combines Taylor equation prediction with sensor-based deviation detection (force uptrend, surface finish degradation).

loops.loop_1_build: Taylor-based integral predictor. Residual tracking from force signature. Fault probability scorer.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Tool wear specialist + ML reviewer. Check: Taylor C/n coefficient sources, residual bias.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Predict end-of-life within 15% of real failure on 20 tracked tool lifecycles.

units.description: ToolWearRealtimeEstimatorEngine — online wear via Taylor+ sensors — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: AdaptiveRPMSolverEngine — dynamic RPM command
units.intent: Given live ae, material, tool, wear, compute new RPM. Uses MS4 LOC formula: RPM_new = RPM_base × (ae_ref / ae_actual)^0.3 with safety cap from spindle/stability envelope.

loops.loop_1_build: RPM calc with safety cap (min from stability lobes, spindle max, chatter boundary). Rate-limited commands (slew-limited to prevent thermal shock).
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Control theory specialist + safety-physics. Check: stability margin preservation, slew rate against spindle spec.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: RPM adaptations keep chatter-free on 30 test cuts, MRR +10% avg vs static RPM.
exit_gate.rollback_procedure: git revert; reset to static RPM.

units.description: AdaptiveRPMSolverEngine — dynamic RPM command — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: AdaptiveFeedSolverEngine — dynamic feed with chip thinning
units.intent: Compute adaptive feed per tooth (fz). Chip thinning factor = sqrt(ae/D) for radial engagement < 50%. Feed = fz × z × RPM with fz adjusted to maintain target chip thickness.

loops.loop_1_build: Chip thinning formula. Target chip thickness lookup per material/tool. Machine feed limit enforcement.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Cutting mechanics expert + safety-physics. Check: chip formation adequacy (not too thin → rubbing), tool deflection budget.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Chip thickness within target ±15% on 30 test cuts, tool life within 10% of prediction.

units.description: AdaptiveFeedSolverEngine — dynamic feed with chip thinning — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: AdaptiveStepoverSolverEngine — dynamic stepover for constant MRR
units.intent: Adjust stepover during 3D adaptive roughing to maintain constant MRR. If tool starts cutting easier (low ae), allow larger stepover on next pass; if hard, reduce.

loops.loop_1_build: MRR target from baseline. Stepover from MRR = ae × ap × feed. Safety bound (max stepover per tool D — typically 50% D max).
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: CAM expert + safety-physics. Check: engagement staying below max, adaptive transitions not abrupt.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: MRR within ±10% of target on 15 test programs.

units.intent: Define hard safety envelope: spindle torque ceiling, tool deflection ceiling, chatter boundary, thermal ceiling. All adaptive commands must stay within. S(x) >= 0.70 hard gate.

loops.loop_1_build: Envelope bounds loader (from machine profile + tool profile). S(x) computation per command. Reject-if-unsafe logic.

loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Workholding envelope (fixture rigidity), coolant flow minimum.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: 0 tool breakage, 0 spindle overload events in 40-hour burn-in.
exit_gate.rollback_procedure: git revert; require manual safety-physics re-review.

units.title: MachineCommOverrideBridgeEngine — push adaptive commands (HARDENED)
units.intent: Deliver RPM/feed override commands to machine control via MTConnect/OPC-UA/FOCAS/THINC. Feed override %, spindle override %. Controller-specific dialects. Safety-critical channel: enforces token-bucket rate-limit, mTLS authenticated transport, deadman-timeout with abort-on-no-ACK, replay-nonce in HMAC to defeat replay attacks.

safety_requirements.token_bucket: Rate-limit ≤ 10 overrides/sec per machine. Burst capacity = 20. Reject (and alarm) on exceed.
safety_requirements.mtls: Mutual TLS with pinned certs; min TLS 1.3; reject on cert validation failure. Per-machine client cert rotation ≤ 90d.
safety_requirements.deadman_timeout: 200ms per-command ACK deadline. On timeout: abort command, escalate to safe state (feed-hold), alarm.
safety_requirements.replay_nonce: Monotonic counter included in HMAC-SHA256; server tracks last_seen_nonce per client; rejects if nonce <= last_seen.
safety_requirements.sx_gate: SafetyEngine.evaluate() must return S(x) >= 0.70 before override is transmitted. HARD BLOCK if below.

loops.loop_1_build: Controller adapter interface with token-bucket wrapper. FOCAS C library binding (mTLS). THINC API (mTLS). Haas REST (mTLS). Command queue with HMAC+nonce, retries capped at 3 with exponential backoff. Deadman timer on every ACK path; expired ACK → feed-hold + alarm. S(x) precheck integrated via prism_safety dispatcher before transmit.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Machine integration expert + application security. Check: mTLS cert pinning correctness, token-bucket leak rate, deadman escalation path, replay-nonce monotonicity under concurrent callers, authenticated channels, no command flooding, controller firmware compatibility.
loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Heidenhain, Siemens 840D adapters; HSM token-bucket tuning; alarm ingestion into prism_monitoring.
loops.loop_4_tie_up: JSDoc. Controller compatibility matrix. Threat model doc. Security review sign-off.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Override commands land within 200ms on 3 controller types (Fanuc, Okuma, Haas). Replay attack simulation rejects all replayed packets. mTLS cert-rotation drill passes. Token-bucket drops requests >10/s cleanly. Deadman triggers feed-hold on forced 300ms-stall injection.
exit_gate.abort_criteria: If controller rejects > 1% of commands; ANY security test fails (replay accepted, mTLS bypass, nonce regression); deadman fails to escalate within 250ms budget.

exit_gate.abort_criteria: ANY safety event or > 30 min cumulative downtime.
